pure-announcement.rationale: This is the ratified OASIS specification text itself, not an announcement about it.

duplicate.rationale: No supplied nearest concept (code knowledge graph, retrieval composition, context layer) covers a static-analysis results interchange format.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is the normative primary source, with a published JSON schema that implementers can validate real logs against.

durability.rationale: SARIF 2.1.0 is a finalized OASIS standard (plus errata) whose core model — runs, results, locations, code flows, baselining, taxonomies — has been stable for years and underpins tooling such as GitHub code scanning.

actionability.rationale: An implementer can build emitters or consumers directly against its normative MUST/SHALL clauses, and adopting it settles the interchange-format decision for a static-analysis toolchain.

atomicity.rationale: Despite the spec's length, everything serves one stateable idea: a standard JSON format so any static-analysis tool's results can be aggregated and managed uniformly.
